info.title: Trilho
info.description: Trilho’s payments API — Pix, boleto, card, split, and subscriptions. Base `https://api.trilho.dev/v1`, JSON bodies, secret key as a bearer token. See API Reference › Introduction for the full contract on authentication, versioning, and errors.

tags.name: Cobranças
tags.description: Create, retrieve, cancel, and capture charges in Pix, boleto, and card.

tags.name: Clientes
tags.description: Store who pays, to reuse across charges and subscriptions.

tags.name: Assinaturas
tags.description: Recurring charges over a customer and a saved method.

tags.name: Reembolsos
tags.description: Return, in full or in part, an already-paid charge.

tags.name: Eventos
tags.description: The history of what webhooks delivered.

post.description: Creates a charge in `pix`, `boleto`, or `cartao`. The response is `201` even when the method declines — a decline is an outcome, not an error.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key you choose, up to 255 characters. Repeating the call with the same key and the same body, within 24 hours, returns the original response instead of creating again.

schema.description: What describes the charge to create.

moeda.description: Only `BRL` today. The field exists for the day it is not.

pagamento.description: The data of the chosen method. The inner key is the method name.

token.description: The token from browser-side tokenization, never the card number.

201.description: The charge was created — even when `status` comes back `recusada`.

400.description: The request is not valid against the contract.

401.description: The key is missing, invalid, or from another environment.

422.description: The request is valid and the values are not. `detalhes` carries all of them.

post.description: Cancels a `pendente` charge. An already-`paga` charge does not cancel — its path is `POST /reembolsos`.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. The header says how many calls remain.

bearerAuth.description: Secret key in the `Authorization` header. `tk_test_` talks to the sandbox, `tk_live_` to production.

Erro.description: The error envelope. `codigo` is stable and is what you handle in code; `mensagem` is for humans and may change without notice.

mensagem.example: A chave de idempotência já foi usada com um corpo diferente.
mensagem.description: The human-readable description. Never handle by it — handle by `codigo`.

detalhes.description: Present on `422` — one item per invalid request field.

motivo.description: Why the value did not pass.

Cobranca.description: A charge — the central Trilho record. `pagamento` carries only the key of the chosen method; the other two stay null.

status.description: The current state. `recusada` is a successful `201` — the request was correct and the financial system said no.

moeda.description: Only `BRL` today. The field exists for the day it is not.

capturar.description: Card only. `false` authorizes without capturing — see `POST /cobrancas/{id}/capturar`.

referencia_externa.description: Your own identifier — order, invoice. Echoed back without interpretation.

motivo_recusa.description: Present only when `status` is `recusada`. The full catalog is in Operation › Decline codes.

pagamento.description: The data of the chosen method. The key that is not `null` is the one named by `meio`.

copia_e_cola.description: The copy-and-paste payload — what the bank app reads when there is no camera.

expira_em.description: When the QR stops being payable.

linha_digitavel.description: The digits you type in when there is no barcode reader.

vencimento.description: The deadline for payment without interest.

cartao.description: Present when `meio` is `cartao`. What is left of the card after tokenization, plus the authorization outcome.

ultimos_quatro.description: The last four digits. It is all you may show the payer.

parcelas.description: From 1 to 12. Each installment amount is rounded by the issuer.

verificacoes.description: What the issuer checked at authorization. **This is the fourth level, and it is the ceiling of the system.**

cvv.description: `nao_conferido` with an approved authorization happens, and accepting it is your own risk decision.

endereco.description: `parcial` is usually a correct postal code with a wrong street number.

autenticacao_3ds.description: Only `autenticado` transfers chargeback liability to the issuer.

split.description: Present when the charge splits the amount across recipients. See Payment methods › Split.

recebedor_id.description: The identifier of the registered recipient.

valor.description: In cents, and the sum of shares never exceeds `valor`.

Cliente.description: A customer — who pays. Storing the customer once and reusing the `id` is what lets you save a card and a subscription.

email.description: Used for receipts and declined-charge notifications.

documento.description: CPF or CNPJ, digits only — no punctuation.

endereco.description: Required for boleto and for card address verification.

numero.description: The number, as a string — some addresses have none.

metadados.description: Free-form, yours. Trilho neither reads nor validates the content.

Assinatura.description: A subscription — recurring charge over a customer and a saved method.

status.description: `inadimplente` is the state after all retries of a charge fail, without automatic cancellation.

meio.description: Boleto does not recur on its own — it is not on this list.

nome.description: The plan name, yours — Trilho does not validate it against a catalog.

Reembolso.description: A refund — the total or partial return of an already-paid charge.

valor.description: In cents. Partial is allowed — the sum of refunds never exceeds the original amount.

motivo.description: Free-form, yours. Shows on the payer statement when the method supports it.

status.description: Pix and boleto complete in minutes; card can take days, depending on the issuer.

Evento.description: An event — what a webhook delivers. `dados` varies by `tipo`; the full catalog is in Webhooks › Event catalog.

id.description: The event identifier, prefixed `evt_`. It is the deduplication key.

ocorrido_em.description: When the event occurred — not when it reached your server.

versao_api.description: The API version under which the event was emitted.
